text:
sara_support: Acme ops ping — seeing intermittent 502s + long tail latency (3-8s) on hosted inference for a specific workspace. Customer reports spike after sending multi-turn prompts with ~6k prompt tokens. They see a 502 Bad Gateway and then a couple of successful responses. Attached example x-request-id: a1f4-7b3c-9d2.

acme_ops: Yep. Happened 4x in last 30m. Happens on both streaming and non-streaming calls. We're on eu-west-1, model=llama-3-13b, using SDK v1.4. Client logs show `connection reset by peer` right after a 502.

sara_support: Thanks. Can you paste a minimal repro curl + SDK snippet? Also include which auth method (api key / bearer) and whether you use a proxy.

acme_ops: curl repro:

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"llama-3-13b","input":"<large prompt ...>","max_tokens":512}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Node SDK snippet:

```
const r = await Redwood.generate({ model: 'llama-3-13b', input: longPrompt, stream: false })
```

We're not using a customer-side proxy, standard cloud NAT. No unusual network throttling on our side.

sara_support: Got it. Initial triage: capturing HAR from customer, requesting server-side request IDs and gateway logs. @deepak_sre can you take network/proxy side? Looks like gateway returned 502 before the request reached the runtime.

deepak_sre: On it. I pulled the gateway logs for the x-request-id provided. I see `upstream reset` lines and an `err: 502` from our edge proxy to the runtime pool at ~1898765408. There are also short bursts of TLS handshake timeouts right before resets. No evidence of authentication failure. Headers show `x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 6300` in one of the failures.

marta_eng: I also checked runtime metrics for that model and timeframe. Some instances hit high memory/GC pauses while processing large KV-cache growth for long prompts. We recently rolled a model bundle variant with slightly different attention kernel — could be causing longer per-request processing in unlucky edge cases.

sam_support: Customer also mentioned duplicate billing events: two requests logged where they only issued one. Could be SDK retry looping when it sees 5xx. They use SDK default retry settings.

chris_devex: If the SDK retries on a 502 mid-stream it can reopen a new request, which would appear as double usage. We should confirm whether the SDK considered the 502 non-idempotent and retried.

sara_support: OK plan:
- deepak: gather tcpdump from the edge during next incident window and check keepalive/handshake failures.
- marta: reproduce locally with long prompts against the rolled bundle to catch GC/processing stalls.
- chris: propose SDK change to avoid automatic retry on gateway 502 for non-idempotent generate calls, or at least circuit-breaker in front.
- sam: hold billing adjustments until we confirm double-requests are from client-side retries or server-side duplicate responses.

acme_ops: ETA for next repro window is ~1h. We'll keep captures running and post logs.

(40m later)

deepak_sre: Captured tcpdump and proxy traces. Observed TCP keepalive FIN from runtime side consistently ~5s into heavy requests, followed by `RST` and 502 to client. IPs for runtime side were ephemeral; we saw abrupt worker process exits for a couple of runtime pods with OOM-kill messages around same time.

marta_eng: Reproduced locally with prompt ~6k tokens on the same model variant. Heap spikes then GC > 2s pause which blocks worker and triggers upstream timeout in our proxy. Root cause likely a memory regression in the new kernel variant that increases KV cache peak during long contexts.

sara_support: Good find. Risk assessment — could affect other customers sending long contexts. Proposed immediate mitigations:
1) Roll back the recent model bundle to previous kernel for hosted pool serving that model (stop-gap).
2) Short-term: increase proxy upstream timeout to 15s for that model route while rollback occurs.
3) SDK: patch retry logic to not auto-retry on 502 for generation calls and add an opt-in for aggressive retry.
4) Customer comms: inform Acme Ops and offer to route their workspace to Dedicated pool for guaranteed capacity while fix rolls.

deploy-bot: deploy started: rollback/model-kernel-rollback (initiated by marta_eng)

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: rollback/model-kernel-rollback @ 1898765665 :white_check_mark:

marta_eng: Rollback complete. Verified runtime pods stable under similar load in staging. Also added a short-term memory guard in the runtime that rejects requests exceeding 8k context tokens with 400 and clear error message.

deepak_sre: Increased proxy upstream timeout for that route to 15s. Watching.

chris_devex: SDK PR opened to change default retry behavior. Summary: do not retry generate calls on 5xx except 429/503 with exponential backoff; add `maxRetries` default=0 for non-idempotent endpoints. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/1287

sam_support: Customer update draft to send:
- root cause: memory regression in recent model lib causing worker stalls and upstream resets
- mitigation: rolled back bundle + increased proxy timeout; monitoring in place
- next steps: optional Dedicated route if you want fast mitigation; SDK update incoming to reduce duplicate billing risk

acme_ops: Thanks. We'll validate. Any billing remediation process we should start if we see duplicate token charges?

sara_support: If we confirm duplicate charges from our side we'll issue a billing credit. For now please collect any x-request-id values and timestamps. We'll reopen billing once we have solid evidence.

(10m later)

deepak_sre: No further 502s in the 30m after rollback; proxy upstream times now show <1s for successful requests. We'll keep monitoring for 6h.

marta_eng: Created a regression ticket to add memory safety tests for kernel variants and to gate future rollouts: TKT-5493.

sara_support: Sending customer email now. Marking thread: monitoring -> resolved if no new errors in 6h. Thanks all :thumbsup:

acme_ops: Confirmed no new 502s. Appreciate the quick turnaround — will follow up if we see anything else. :pray:
